heroIntro: Hi, I'm Alisa. I'm 12 and I love drawing people, animals, and the stories that pop into my head. I also like saving the small surprises of each day.
heroImageAlt: An artistic portrait for Alisa's homepage
aboutBody: My first crayon drawing was a round little cat. Later, I joined art contests for fun and drew friends' pets. Drawing is still how I explore the world and share a little joy.
worksIntro: A few favorite pieces. Each drawing is a little world waiting to be discovered.
dailyIntro: Sometimes it's an evening walk; sometimes it's a doodle with no plan at all.
